listening-prea1-01: I have a small cat. It is orange. It is sitting in a blue box.
listening-prea1-02: Look at the birds. There are two birds sitting on a branch.
listening-prea1-03: This is my favourite fruit. It is yellow. I like eating bananas.
listening-a1-01: It is raining outside. There are grey clouds in the sky and a puddle under the tree.
listening-a1-02: Mia and Ben are in their classroom. Mia is giving Ben a blue pencil. There is an open book on their desk.
listening-a1-03: We are at the zoo. I can see a giraffe, an elephant and two monkeys. The elephant is eating leaves.
listening-a2-01: I was doing my homework when my red pencil broke. My friend lent me her blue pencil, so I could finish my work.
listening-a2-02: We wanted to go swimming, but the pool was closed. We went to the park instead. I played with a ball while my friends read a book and rode a bicycle.
listening-a2-03: The giraffe was taller than the elephant. I enjoyed watching them, but my favourite animals were the two monkeys sitting together on a branch.
